description: Systemic survival: needs, gathering/crafting, base-building, escalating threat, resource economy. Merges onto core.

threat_escalation.desc: Nights / waves / spawns harden over time (HazardSystem + spawns).

resource_economy.desc: Sources <-> sinks balanced; resource-loop-closure: no needed consumable sink without a reachable source.

death_penalty_model.desc: Death consequence: permadeath / drop-on-death / respawn penalty (decide early; ripples through save + balance).

weather_exposure.desc: DayNight / weather as a survival threat (exposure, temperature).

save_load.desc: ELEVATED to save-integrity: save -> reload -> deep-diff every persisted subsystem == identical.

starter_scaffold.notes: player + needs HUD + one craftable + a hostile night

starter.description: Survival starter - natural terrain to gather and survive on. Build the loop with the farming-survival-loop recipe.
